title: Calendar Filter – Multi-Class Filter – SF Calendar – Two Classes Checked After Course Select – Only Lessons With Both Classes Shown
description: BR-7 (BR-35) — Decision Table (Regression) — Confirms ALL-match (AND logic) still works in the new flow: course selected first, then two classes checked shows only lessons containing BOTH classes.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course A" has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Group lessons: G1 (Class Alpha only), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), G3 (Class Beta only), G4 (Class Gamma only) in current week
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions: 1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter\n2. Check Class Alpha\n3. Also check Class Beta
steps_result: 1. Class section appears; Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma all unchecked\n2. Calendar shows Lesson G1 and Lesson G2; G3 and G4 are hidden\n3. Calendar shows only Lesson G2 — the only lesson with BOTH Class Alpha AND Class Beta; G1, G3, G4 are hidden
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > ALL-Match Logic – Regression

title: Calendar Filter – Multi-Class Filter – One of Two Checked Classes Unchecked – Broader Lesson Results Shown
description: BR-7, BR-5 — Decision Table — Confirms that unchecking one of two active class filters relaxes the AND condition and displays a broader set of lessons.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Course A has 3 classes; Group lessons G1–G4 exist in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A", check Class Alpha and Class Beta
2. Uncheck Class Beta
3. Observe the calendar
4. Confirm Course A is still selected
steps_result:
1. Calendar shows only Lesson G2 (AND logic: has both Alpha AND Beta)
2. Class Beta is unchecked; only Class Alpha remains checked
3. Calendar now shows Lesson G1 (Class Alpha only) and Lesson G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta) — single-class filter applied
4. "Course A – Introduction to Math" remains selected in the Course filter
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > ALL-Match Logic – Regression
